totemautoreset.config.title: TotemCounter Auto Reset
totemautoreset.option.resetOnOwnDeath.to: Trigger TotemCounter's reset when you die.
totemautoreset.option.resetOnOpponentDea: Trigger TotemCounter's reset when the player you are fighting dies. Your opponent is the last player you exchanged damage with or hit.
totemautoreset.option.combatTimeout.tool: Seconds without any damage exchanged before your opponent is forgotten.
totemautoreset.option.showToast.tooltip: ON: use TotemCounter's own reset, including its "Successfully reset pop counter" toast (same as its reset key). OFF: reset silently.
